updateTo.name: Walkway 0.1.1
updateTo.notes:
Signed and notarized Walkway preview for Apple silicon Macs.

This release establishes the preview update channel. Versions 0.1.1 and 0.1.2 use the same tested application code; 0.1.2 verifies delivery of a newer signed version.

Download the ZIP, extract Walkway.app, and move it to Applications. Keep your existing app until you have finished active work. Existing unsigned previews need this one-time manual installation. Signed builds can use **Walkway → Check for Update**.

SHA256SUMS is included for download verification. These are early previews; broader compatibility and workflow testing is still ongoing.
